Accommodation.name: House of Hope
Accommodation.description: Temporary lodging for young cancer patients treated at Southern Philippines Medical Center, and their families. Over 200 pediatric cancer patients come to the SPMC Cancer Institute each year, from Mindanao and also Central Visayas and Bicol.
Accommodation.operator: House of Hope Foundation for Kids with Cancer Inc.

branches.location: Southern Philippines Medical Center Compound, J. P. Laurel Avenue, Poblacion Buhangin, Davao City, Davao del Sur 8000
Margarita Village along J.P. Laurel Avenue, Davao City

eligibility: young cancer patients seeking medical treatment inside the SPMC
Accommodation.capacity: SPMC house: four bedrooms, three bathrooms, a kitchen, a common area, and a play area (2019). Up to three families share one room (2023).

Accommodation.name: Balay Dalangpan
Accommodation.description: Free temporary shelter in Davao City for South Cotabato patients receiving care at Southern Philippines Medical Center, and their caregivers, for those who cannot afford to rent a boarding house.
Accommodation.operator: An ancestral home of the Tamayo family, kept open by South Cotabato Governor Reynaldo S. Tamayo, Jr.
eligibility: Patients and their caregivers who are receiving care at the Southern Philippine Medical Center
provides: Free water, electricity, and ambulance services for patient transport between South Cotabato and Davao City

Accommodation.name: Capernaum
Accommodation.description: Care facility inside the SPMC compound. Cancer patients coming from far away are offered free board and lodging.

branches.location: Inside the Southern Philippines Medical Center compound, J.P. Laurel Ave., Bajada, Davao City

Accommodation.name: Red Planet Davao
Accommodation.description: Budget hotel on J.P. Laurel Avenue. Its official page says "Damosa IT Park and Davao Medical Center are nearby" (Davao Medical Center is SPMC's former name).

branches.location: JP LAUREL AVE., BUHANGIN (POB), BUHANGIN DISTRICT 8000 DAVAO CITY DAVAO DEL SUR PHILIPPINES

Accommodation.cost: Paid. Rates on the hotel's website.
